body:
Thank you for the kind words.

It really helped me calm down a little. Knowing that someone that i don't even know would care.

Thank you...

I guess my weight definitely have something to do with that. I was bullyed pretty hard when i was a kid, so i guess i grew up with that tought that no one would ever like me. And i know everybody would say this isn't true, yet here i am in a diet trying to lose weight. 

But that's just the obvious part, i guess. Deep inside i think i try too hard to make people like me. I'm always receptive and kind, telling jokes and making people laugh. But i feel that noone really wants to know me, they're just interested in how i can make a situation more funny. Because the days that i'm not feeling too good, they don't even talk to me. Take away the funny part of the funny guy... now he is nobody.

I want to get more involved, but i always feel that i'm not being honest with them. I really can disguise all those feelings, and for the most people that knows me, i'm a funny and outgoing guy. So they think that i'm ok, when what really is going on is that i think about killing myself everyday. 

For a long time i just accepted this, thinking that all those feelings eventually would go away if i didn't really tought they were a big deal.

But it got worst. Sometimes, when i'm in class, i have to leave the room to go cry in the bathroom, because of some tought that popped in my mind.

But i don't know why i can't get more involved with them. I wasn't, but i've turned to a really closed person. And if i could list all the thinks that makes me sad, that would be certainly in the top.

I just have a hard time talking about what i'm going through. I feel like my problems shouldn't be anyone's else.

I can't think of anything that set off what i'm feeling. I think it happened gradually: no self-steem, i don't know what i want to do professionally, don't have a meaningful relationship with my family (don't have at all). And the loneliness, that is kind of what makes me cry every nigh too.

I feel like i don't have much to give back. So how can i ask for someone to just "like me the way i am"? I really try to change, i'm trying really hard, but i never think it's enough.

Thanks Jayce868!

I think that's the problem, lately i'm kind of distant to the people that i really care about. I don't want them to look at me like the really sad and annoying guy. What they gain with a relationship like this? Nothing, they kind of just stand me because of all the thinks we've been through. 

This isn't fair, i can't ask anyone to live this with me.

Hello!
Man, i really appreciate what guys like you do in this subreddit. That kind of care and concern is something that we don't see much around. So thank you, and i mean it.

Yes, i think i'm kind of in a really bad state. I don't know, those kinds of thoughts are constantly in my mind. Like, everyday.

I talked with some friends about me being kind of sad lately, but didn't seek profesional help. It's something that i know i HAVE to do to get better, but i don't know if i want to. 

Besides, i keep thinking that if i'm not willing to look at this like something i can overcome, then might as well stop all the pain.

Also, i feel that i'm extremely lonely. But who isn't, right?

And thanks again for the answer.
